items.title: OpenAI wants everyone to call AI data centers 'compute campuses'
items.summary: An OpenAI spokesperson said the term better represents the "role" of AI infrastructure.
items.titleZh: OpenAI希望每个人都把AI数据中心称为“计算园区”
items.summaryZh: OpenAI的一位发言人表示，这个词更好地代表了人工智能基础设施的“作用”。

items.title: Ukraine air raid app apparently hacked as users receive false radiation threat, Air Force says
items.summary: Authorities say there is no threat and have advised the public to follow official channels for information.
items.titleZh: 空军表示，乌克兰空袭应用程序显然遭到黑客攻击，因为用户收到了虚假的辐射威胁
items.summaryZh: 当局表示没有威胁，并建议公众通过官方渠道获取信息。

items.title: AI delivers 'zero financial payoff' to most companies, Apollo economist says
items.summary: "Despite massive investments and widespread hype around artificial intelligence, the technology has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of tech."
items.titleZh: 阿波罗经济学家表示，人工智能为大多数公司带来了“零财务回报”
items.summaryZh: “尽管对人工智能进行了大量投资和广泛宣传，但该技术在技术之外对美国企业没有带来任何财务回报。”

items.title: Elon Musk says he is taking over an old Spam factory and a gun range to expand his Colossus 2 AI complex
items.summary: Elon Musk named the new AI facilities at the Colossus 2 campus "Spam" and "Gun Range."
items.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，他将接管一家旧的垃圾邮件工厂和一个靶场，以扩大他的Colossus 2人工智能综合体
items.summaryZh: 埃隆·马斯克将Colossus 2园区的新人工智能设施命名为“Spam”和“Gun Range”

items.title: Bigger, badder Section 179 tax deduction could POWER UP fleet electrification [update]
items.summary: With national diesel prices inching towards $7/gallon and Tesla’s $290,000 Semi trucks finally making their way to paying customers, it’s worth revisiting how Trump’s One Big, Beautiful Bill Act (OBBA) helped beef up the Section 179 deduction, and look again …
items.titleZh: 更大、更糟糕的第179条税收减免可能会推动车队电气化[更新]
items.summaryZh: 随着全国柴油价格逐渐逼近每加仑7美元，特斯拉的29万美元半挂卡车终于开始向付费客户出售，值得重新审视特朗普的《一大美丽法案》（OBBA）如何帮助加强第179条的扣除，并再次审视…

items.title: Even millionaires are renting. Here are 10 cities they're flocking to.
items.summary: As companies head South, they're bringing their workers with them. It's fueling a surge in millionaire renters across several Southern cities.
items.titleZh: 即使是百万富翁也在租房。以下是他们蜂拥而至的10个城市。
items.summaryZh: 随着公司向南发展，他们也会带上工人。这促使南方几个城市的百万富翁租房者激增。

items.title: Google’s Suncatcher satellite runs AI in orbit and sends a haiku home
items.summary: “Blue marble below”: Google’s Suncatcher satellite sent back its first AI response from orbit, a haiku by its Gemma 4 model.
items.titleZh: 谷歌的太阳捕手卫星在轨道上运行人工智能，并将俳句送回家
items.summaryZh: “下面的蓝色大理石”：谷歌的太阳捕手卫星从轨道上发回了它的第一个人工智能响应，这是Gemma 4型号的俳句。

items.title: Anthropic’s potential $2 trillion IPO could turn staff into millionaires—but the AI firm is asking candidates what they’d do if stock fell to zero
items.summary: With an IPO looming, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei—who has a net worth of $13.6 billion—has reportedly expressed concerns that AI workers are prioritizing money over mission.
items.titleZh: Anthropic潜在的2万亿美元IPO可能会让员工成为百万富翁，但这家人工智能公司正在询问候选人，如果股价跌至零，他们会怎么做
items.summaryZh: 随着首次公开募股的临近，据报道，Anthropic首席执行官Dario Amodei（净资产136亿美元）表示担心人工智能工作者将资金置于任务之上。

items.title: Is Radicalism the Answer?
items.summary: The legal scholar Samuel Moyn argues that moderates have given up on the emancipatory promise of liberalism.
items.summaryZh: 法律学者塞缪尔·莫恩认为，温和派已经放弃了自由主义的解放承诺。

items.title: Why AI is boosting Meta's ad business while hurting Google search
items.summary: The gap between Meta's ad revenue growth and Google's search expansion was the widest it's been since 2021 in the latest quarter.
items.titleZh: 为什么人工智能在损害谷歌搜索的同时促进了Meta的广告业务
items.summaryZh: 在最近一个季度，Meta的广告收入增长与谷歌搜索扩张之间的差距是自2021年以来最大的。

items.title: The Hollywood Color Nerd Who Shot ‘Knives Out’ Explains His Viral iPhone Camera App
items.summary: The Chromagraph Camera app costs $13 dollars and processes iPhone photos with the same color math Rian Johnson’s cinematographer, Steve Yedlin, uses for film.
items.titleZh: 拍摄“刀子”的好莱坞有色人种解释了他的病毒性iPhone相机应用程序
items.summaryZh: Chromagraph Camera应用程序售价13美元，使用Rian Johnson的电影摄影师Steve Yedlin用于电影的相同颜色数学处理iPhone照片。

items.title: This new indie film about an AI startup founder and his family feels less like sci-fi by the day
items.summary: "Anna by the Window" is a glimpse inside the world of Ryan, a teen boy who travels to New York City to reconnect with his AI startup founder brother.
items.titleZh: 这部新的独立电影讲述了一位人工智能初创公司创始人和他的家人，现在感觉不像科幻小说了
items.summaryZh: 《窗边的安娜》是对Ryan世界的一瞥，Ryan是一个十几岁的男孩，他前往纽约市与他的人工智能创业公司创始人兄弟重新建立联系。
